'''Avum Brightplace''' was the quartermaster for the [[Scarlet Crusade]] and was located inside the [[Scarlet Monastery Cathedral|Cathedral]] wing of the [[Scarlet Monastery]]. He was the only source for the [[Gilded Scarlet Crusade Tabard]], which could be bought by a player in ownership of the [[Corrupted Ashbringer]].
